message.reasoning:
I've got $54 against my opponent's $596, and they're sitting on Reading Railroad with 4 houses left in the bank. I'm weighing whether to build another house on one of my light blues, checking which distances from their current position would actually land them on my properties.

Connecticut comes out ahead over Vermont since it's more likely to get hit and the jump from 2 to 3 houses bumps rent from 100 up to 300. He has no monopolies to worry about paying into, so leaving myself with just $4 cash seems acceptable, especially since building also denies him access to the house supply. I'll build on Connecticut.
